meta.name: add-clidash
meta.description: Add clidash — a zero-dependency, read-only web dashboard that derives its tabs and tables at runtime from any CLI that lists resources as JSON. Ships pre-wired for NanoClaw's ncl CLI (agent groups, sessions, channels, users, roles), plus message-activity charts, a log tail, and a read-only file viewer for group skills/CLAUDE.md/profiles.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将任意 JSON 输出 CLI 转为实时 Web 仪表盘
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你有输出 JSON 的 CLI 工具，想快速生成 Web 仪表盘
copy.tagline_en: Turn any JSON-output CLI into a live web dashboard
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a CLI that outputs JSON and want a quick web dashboard

howto.what: 此技能会在项目里加入 clidash——一个零依赖、只读的 Web 仪表盘：它按 ncl 等 CLI 的 JSON 输出在运行时生成资源标签页和表格，另带活动图表、日志尾部与只读文件查看器。
howto.when: 当用户要求为项目添加或配置 clidash 时触发。

say.text: 请添加 clidash 并预配置 ncl 资源总览
say.note: 会复制工具并生成默认配置。

say.text: 把 docker 也接入 clidash 的配置里
say.note: 会以纯配置方式新增 docker 资源标签页。

say.text: 将 clidash 设为 systemd 用户服务并绑定 tailnet IP
say.note: 开放其他设备访问且只绑定私有接口。

howto.what_en: Adds clidash: a zero-dep, read-only web dashboard that builds tabs/tables at runtime from any JSON-listing CLI (ncl, docker, kubectl), plus activity charts, log tail, and read-only file viewer for skills, CLAUDE.md, profiles.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add or configure clidash.

say_en.text: Add clidash and pre-configure the ncl resource overview.
say_en.note: Copies the tool and creates default config.

say_en.text: Also hook docker into the clidash config.
say_en.note: Adds a docker resource tab via config only.

say_en.text: Run clidash as a systemd user service bound to a tailnet IP.
say_en.note: Available from other devices on a private interface.
